entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: One of the larger Edemi Islands on Dominaria, rich in blue and white mana and covered in streams.

entities.name: Shima Pond
entities.description: A pond on Kusho with healing waters.

entities.name: Gosta Dirk
entities.description: Powerful water mage chosen informal leader of Kusho, allied with Kasimir the Lone Wolf.

entities.name: Kasimir the Lone Wolf
entities.description: Ally of Gosta Dirk who stayed behind to delay the Kentsu.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: Ruler of Argenti who rallied the Edemi Islands against Madara.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Emperor of Madara who sent assassins and the Kentsu against the Edemis.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: The empire that fought the Edemi Islands.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Forces sent by Overdark that overran Kusho.

entities.name: Barktooth Warbeard
entities.description: Marshal leading the Kentsu occupation of Kusho.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Used the Sylvan Library to enhance corals and helped kill Halfdane.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: Ally of Ayesha who helped kill Halfdane.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: Planted black mana crystals on Kusho and was killed by Ayesha and Tor.

entities.name: Lady Orca
entities.description: Monstrous servant of Overdark who attacked Kusho.

entities.name: Lord Magnus
entities.description: Ruler of Argenti who gave Ayesha a cure.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Used to communicate across the isles and enhance corals.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: The war between Madara and the Edemi Islands.

events.summary: Orca attacks Kusho on her way to Argenti.
events.quote: Kusho was only attacked by Orca on her way to Argenti.

events.summary: Gosta and Kasimir stay behind to delay the Kentsu while the island evacuates; Kusho is overrun.
events.quote: Kusho was overrun by the Kentsu, who stationed an occupation force there led by marshal Barktooth Warbeard .

events.summary: Ayesha uses the Sylvan Library to enhance the corals and decimate the Kentsu.
events.quote: Ayesha Tanaka used the Sylvan Library to enhance the corals around Kusho to decimate the Kentsu forces.

events.summary: Halfdane plants black mana crystals to poison Kusho's mages; Gosta falls ill.
events.quote: Gosta himself had fallen seriously ill.

events.summary: Ayesha and Tor Wauki remove the crystals and kill Halfdane.
events.quote: she and Tor Wauki killed Halfdane shortly after removing the black mana crystals.
